evals.prompt: 查一下精确字符串 `search_auto_test_on_launch_v1` 最早出自哪个项目，给出 commit-pinned 代码链接并核验 fork/rename 关系。
evals.expected_output: Uses Exa exact/code discovery, cites commit-pinned code, and resolves or explicitly reports repository-origin ambiguity.
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode exact, or an Exa tool directly.
Provides a commit-pinned source URL containing the exact string.
Checks repository identity or fork/rename ambiguity before naming the original project.
Does not add a routing footer, because the user did not ask for one.

evals.prompt: 查一下今天的新加坡 AI 创业新闻，最多给 5 条候选来源，不要使用豆包，也不要启动深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Uses compact current-mode retrieval, returns at most five sources with their dates, and avoids Doubao and deep research.
expectations: Uses search_auto with mode current, or a Brave/Serper news tool.
Returns no more than five source URLs.
Does not use or cite Doubao and does not start deep research.

evals.prompt: 直接读取 https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools 并概括 ToolAnnotations；不要重新搜索这个已知 URL，也不要调用本机不存在的 Jina Reader 或 TinyFish Browser。
evals.expected_output: Fetches the known URL directly with fetch_auto, summarizes ToolAnnotations, and neither searches the URL nor invents unavailable tools.
expectations: Summarizes readOnlyHint and destructiveHint from the requested page.
Uses fetch_auto, or a direct fetch/scrape tool, rather than a search query.
Does not claim to call Jina Reader or TinyFish Browser.

evals.prompt: 帮我研究一下为什么 AI Agent 的网页回答需要 grounding chunks，而不只是搜索摘要。我想让模型直接基于多来源正文回答，控制在约 4096 token；不要启动深度研究，也不要逐页抓取。
evals.expected_output: Uses Brave LLM Context for token-bounded multi-source grounding and avoids separate page fetches and deep research.
expectations: Uses brave_llm_context directly or search_auto in context mode.
Keeps the grounding budget at approximately 4096 tokens.
Does not start deep research or separately fetch each result page.
Uses the returned per-source grounding as evidence rather than treating snippets as a finished answer.

evals.prompt: 快速查一下今天同一个主题的网页资料和新闻报道，希望一次调用拿到两类结果，并返回适合模型引用的相关段落；不要做深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Uses You.com unified Web/News search with query-aware highlights and avoids deep research.
expectations: Uses you_search.
Requests highlights only because query-aware passages were explicitly requested.
Uses both Web and News results when both are returned.
Does not start deep research or fetch every result separately.

evals.prompt: 我要找一组适合 AI Agent 使用的网页检索服务，目标是比较近期官方能力、延迟取舍和给模型使用的正文片段。请把目标拆成 2 到 3 条短查询后一次检索，不要逐页抓取。
evals.expected_output: Uses Parallel Search with a semantic objective and concise search queries and consumes the ranked excerpts.
expectations: Uses parallel_search.
Supplies a self-contained objective plus 2-3 concise searchQueries.
Uses returned excerpts before considering any page fetch.
Does not start deep research or fetch every result separately.

evals.prompt: 有人说某家公司本周宣布了重大收购。我要两个互相独立的检索来源来互相印证，别只信一个搜索引擎，也别做深度研究。
evals.expected_output: Runs one cross-checked current search across two independent indexes and reports which results were corroborated.
expectations: Uses search_auto with crossCheck true and current mode, rather than two unrelated manual searches.
Distinguishes results found by both providers from results found by one.
Does not treat several reposts of one report as independent confirmation.
Does not start deep research.

evals.prompt: 这个页面是重度 JavaScript 渲染的单页应用，普通抓取读不到正文：https://example.com/app 。请把正文读出来，最多 8000 字符。
evals.expected_output: Reads the known URL with fetch_auto at max quality and a character cap.
expectations: Uses fetch_auto with quality max, or Firecrawl scrape directly.
Sets the character cap to about 8000.
Does not search for the URL it already has.
